about: Query API conformance cases (doc/API.md), run against the Python API (python/tests/test_queries.py)
and the JavaScript API (tests/query.test.mjs). Expected answers are derived by hand.
q: [query, args, kwargs] on the Technology; then: [method, args, kwargs] on its result.
Answers are encoded with lengths as exact strings ('29/2'), records as objects with snake_case fields.
pick: a dot path into the answer ('*' maps over a list); error: the error class expected.
Technologies named raw_* are hand-built resolved forms (python/tests/data/raw/), for inputs the resolver never produces.
